pages.title: Shovelnose Catfish
pages.text: The barred sorubim ($(o)Pseudoplatystoma fasciatum$()), or tiger shovelnose catfish, is a predatory catfish of the rivers of the Guianas in northern South America.$(br2)It has a long, flat, shovel-shaped head with long whiskers, and a grey body with dark vertical bars and spots above a white belly.$(br2)It hunts fish at night. Until 2007 its name also covered the similar tiger shovelnoses of the Amazon and Orinoco, which are now separate species.
